_doc.what: The NORD mobile gauntlet loop (docs/gauntlet/gta-mobile.md): one driven lap through the five replica capture streets, measured against a 33.3 ms frame budget while the stream keeps its 60 fps caps. Source: openspec/changes/nord-mobile-gauntlet.
_doc.units: Lengths in metres (_m), speeds in m/s (_m_s), times in seconds (_s), frame times in milliseconds (_ms), memory in MiB (_mib), bitrates in kbit/s (_kbps). Sizes are [width, height] in pixels.
_doc.sync: Source/Quebec/QuebecGauntletModel.h holds the same driving numbers, mode settings, frame thresholds and exit codes. Scripts/test_gauntlet_model.py fails when they differ. Scripts/make_gauntlet_route.py reads stops, order and eye_fov_deg and writes Source/Quebec/QuebecGauntletRoute.h.
_doc.version: Schema version. Raise it when a key changes meaning.
_doc.map: The map every run loads. The Plateau replica is merged into it.
_doc.road_set: The road segments the route follows: the set QuebecDistrict::ForWorld gives the LaFontaine map.
_doc.camera_manifest: The file that holds the stop cameras (its 'cameras' list). Eye positions and targets live only there.
_doc.route_header: The generated C++ header with the stops in drive order.
_doc.stops: One entry per stop: label (used in logs, leg names and shot names), name (the street) and camera (the 'name' of a camera in camera_manifest).
_doc.order: Drive order by label. The loop returns from the last stop to the first.
_doc.eye_fov_deg: Horizontal field of view of the <stop>-eye views: the game camera's 85 degrees (Preview/Replica/README.md).
_doc.names: How logs and files name a leg, a stop and a still. {from} and {to} are stop labels, {sky} is a key of skies, {view} is an entry of views.per_stop.
_doc.route: Checks on the loop that QuebecGauntletModel.h BuildLoop makes over road_set: total length in metres, the largest distance from a stop eye to its road point, and the end position. The loop never turns back. Rachel at the park (S4) is a dead-end branch in road_set, so the S4 road point is on the nearest through road. The car turns round the block south of Sherbrooke (S1). The junction-to-junction path was 3568 m and the driven line with rounded corners 3475 m on the road set of October 2026.
_doc.drive: The in-game driver: speed cap, the police stuck rule (reverse_for_s after stuck_after_s below stuck_speed_m_s with throttle), the stall rule (less than stall_progress_m along the loop in stall_s fails with exit stuck), the lap time limit (driving time, holds excluded) and the largest lateral error from the route.
_doc.modes: Per -NordGauntletMode: delay_s after the subsystem starts before driving (stream waits for the 60 s idle warm-up plus the 30 s grace, so NordFriend1 is asleep), warm_laps driven and discarded (shader compiles), laps measured (-NordGauntletLaps overrides it), hold_s at each stop (0 drives through), ambient false adds world_flags.look, and sky_switch true takes both skies at each hold.
_doc.confirm_laps: Measured laps per run when a winner and the baseline are confirmed. The result is the median of the per-lap p95 values.
_doc.world_flags: Command-line flags. 'all' goes on every run, 'look' on look runs only.
_doc.gauntlet_flags: The flags the game reads. Each value is the flag text before its argument.
_doc.exit_codes: Process exit codes from the subsystem. Python judges budgets; the game never does.
_doc.skies: Pinned sky presets. Every run passes one 'args' list. A run without both -NordHour= and -NordWeather= exits with exit_codes.no_sky.
_doc.sky_order: The order of skies in reports and look runs.
_doc.views: Fixed stills at each stop: per_stop names, settle times before the shot, and whether the HUD shows.
_doc.sizes: Render and stream sizes from Browser/config.mjs streamDimensions for the 844x390 and 390x844 phone viewports. rung 0 is the 1280 edge, rung 1 the 960 edge.
_doc.size_use: Which sizes each pass uses: tune (the search), confirm (winner and baseline) and stream (stream runs).
_doc.stream: Stream rungs measured in the stream run only. A change to the ladder in Browser/config.mjs is a recommendation for the user, never automatic.
_doc.budgets: native: the per-run and per-leg gate after the warm laps (frames strictly over a threshold count). feasible: the tuner's 10 percent margin on the night-rain landscape lap; the gate itself stays at 33.3 ms. stream: the stream gate and the two-viewer guard. look: the visual check.
_doc.knobs: Ladders for the tuner, cheapest step first. Each step is a {cvar: value} object; a candidate is the baseline profile with one step of each knob applied. baseline_step indexes the step equal to today's stream profile, or is null when the stream profile does not set the CVar (the host readback gives today's value). A knob with enabled false is skipped until its enable_when note is true.
_doc.requires: Knob dependencies the tuner never breaks: when knob is at from_step or higher, needs_knob must be at needs_from_step or higher. verified false means the rule was written from memory of the engine and needs a host check.
_doc.pending_knobs: Knobs named in the design that have no ladder yet.
_doc.profiles: baseline is today's stream profile: execcmds is Scripts/browser_streaming.py QUALITY verbatim, and cvars is its effective value per CVar (later entries win). ceiling is the desktop release look used as the visual reference.
_doc.search: The greedy climb: candidate limit, the smallest ms cost used in the efficiency ratio, repeat counts, tie rules and the GPU target used when steps are combined.
_doc.durations: Estimates used for planning a GPU window. lap_estimate_s is the driving time of one lap of the kinematic car in Scripts/gauntlet_model_test.cpp (296 s in perf mode, 307 s with the stop easing of look and stream mode). candidate_estimate_s is one perf run (load, delay, warm and measured lap) plus one look run (load, delay, one lap with a 24 s hold at each stop). Both are estimates until the host measures a lap.

knobs.note: QUALITY does not set sg.ShadingQuality, so today's value is the engine default. Read it back on the host before the baseline run.

knobs.enable_when: r.Nanite.ShowStats shows Nanite meshes on the route.
knobs.note: Higher values are coarser and cheaper. Step 1 is the engine default (unverified).

requires.why: sg.ReflectionQuality 2 and up selects Lumen reflections, which expect Lumen GI (sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality 2 and up).
